claims.source: Recall transfer item for this lesson; scenario values are stipulated in the question. The why applies the lesson's own model and limits (see this lesson's idea, limit and formula claims). Recall patch by learning-designer (session 2, 2026-10-14), applied by session 1.

recall.question: Cups are 9 cm across, with a 3 cm handle. Side by side, with handles not allowed to overlap, how many fit across a 48 cm tray?
recall.why: Each cup needs its full envelope, 9 + 3 = 12 cm: 48 ÷ 12 = 4. Counting only the 9 cm body gives 5, and they collide at the handles. Other layouts may interleave handles.
